name: kpi-card
title: KPI Card
description: A dashboard KPI tile — a large Stat in Card chrome with an optional hint, delta line, sparkline and whole-tile link — plus KpiGrid, the grid of tiles sized by its container width.

meta.whenToUse: A row of headline numbers at the top of a dashboard or report, each with its own trend, change and optional link to the list behind it.
meta.whenNotToUse: A compact strip of counts on a home page (StatGroup), the facts of one record (Stat or PropertyList), or a full chart (Chart).
